additional_info.subject: RE: ID0412825-DC/Si-D/FR-[2YwMCs] Faulted 1/3 CRM:00798002002
additional_info.body:
Dear Gregoire DESMOUTIER,
I hope this message finds you well.
We have thoroughly analyzed the logs regarding the outlets being out of order. Based on our findings, the issues were due to the following errors:
COAP Error
Reboot requested
Outlet not ready - EVSE not in operating mode
Charger soft reboot requested
Please note that these errors were temporary, and all outlets are now active. Additionally, there are no active error flags remaining.
Given that the situation has been resolved, we would like to confirm whether we can proceed with closing the case.
Kindly let us know if you require any further information or assistance.
Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
